Effective December 1, 2019, the meter names of Azure Monitor custom metrics will change.

There won't be a pricing impact from this change, but you will need to modify billing routines that rely on names.

See the table below for the changes.

Resource GUID (meter ID)

Old service name

New service name

Service type

Old resource name

New resource name

Region name

Old EA portal product name

New EA portal product name
